detailed_description:
The target video uses a cinematic classical Chinese romance style with soft diffused daylight, cool misty tones, and gentle rain atmosphere.
[Shot 1] 00:00‑00:03.5 A wide establishing shot opens on <Subject 3>, the misty West Lake with its wet stone arched bridge, weeping willows, distant pagoda half-veiled in fog, and light rain dimpling the grey-green water. In the middle of the bridge, <Subject 2>, Xu Xian in the light-grey scholar’s robe with hair in a blue-ribboned topknot, holds <Subject 4>, the open brown oil-paper umbrella slightly tilted to cover both of them. Beside him walks <Subject 1>, Bai Niangzi in the light-pink floral hanfu with pink hair ornaments and red sash, lifting her skirt hem clear of the wet stones. Rain taps the umbrella canopy. The camera slowly dollies in as they walk toward camera. <Subject 2> (S1) glances sideways with mild embarrassment and says in a gentle scholarly male voice, [Chinese] 娘子，这雨来得也太急了，伞只有这一把……
[Shot 2] At 00:03.5, the shot cuts to a medium two-shot tracking beside them on the bridge. Raindrops bead on <Subject 4>’s brown canopy as <Subject 2> awkwardly shifts the umbrella more toward <Subject 1>, leaving his own right shoulder exposed to the drizzle. <Subject 1> (S2) notices, covers a smile with her sleeve, and replies in a clear soft youthful female voice with playful warmth, [Chinese] 相公把伞全让给我，自己淋成落汤鸡，回头可别怪小青笑话你。 She lightly tugs the umbrella shaft back toward the center so both are half-covered. <Subject 2> (S1) chuckles, rain darkening a patch on his grey sleeve, and answers, [Chinese] 淋湿一点无妨，总比娘子的花衣裳糟了强。
[Shot 3] At 00:06.8, the shot cuts to a closer medium shot favoring their faces under the umbrella rim, with blurred willow leaves and misty lake behind. <Subject 1> tilts her head with soft amusement, <Subject 2> adjusts the umbrella to the middle shyly, they gaze at each other and smile gently. They take two slow steps forward in light rain, the distant pagoda stays faint in fog, the frame freezes on their tender shared smile at 00:10.000.
overall_soundscape:
Continuous soft rain patter on stone, water, and the oil-paper umbrella canopy, with distant muted lake ambience and occasional light footsteps on the wet bridge.
non_diegetic_music:
A gentle traditional Chinese score with slow guzheng plucks and soft dizi flute, light and warm in tone, soft and subtle during dialogue.
